parameters.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

delete.summary: AdminDeleteOwner soft-deletes all files and quota for an owner (admin only).

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

get.summary: AdminGetQuota returns a user's quota (admin only).

put.summary: AdminSetQuota sets a user's quota (admin only).

post.summary: AdminSoftDeleteOwnerFiles soft-deletes all files for an owner (admin only).

get.summary: AdminListProviders lists all storage providers (admin only).
ListMyAuditLogs lists audit logs for the calling user.
ListMyFiles lists files owned by the calling user.
GetMyFile returns details of a file owned by the calling user.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

patch.summary: UpdateMyFile updates metadata of a user's file.

post.summary:
GenerateCDNURL returns a CDN-fronted signed URL (with expiry) for an
already-uploaded file. Caller must own the file. If ops is non-empty,
the URL carries image-processing parameters (Aliyun x-oss-process);
S3/CloudFront providers reject ops with CDN_IMAGE_PROCESSING_UNSUPPORTED.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: file_id is the already-uploaded file to generate a CDN URL for.

post.summary: GenerateDownloadURL returns a pre-signed download URL.
GenerateProcessURL returns a URL with image processing parameters.

get.summary:
ListMyFilesPaged lists files owned by the calling user with traditional
offset pagination. Use this when the caller needs total_count and page
numbers (UI list views with page navigation). For stable iteration under
concurrent writes (background scans, exports), use ListMyFiles instead.

put.summary:
SetOwnerQuota overwrites an owner's total quota. Business-facing (e.g.
pay-service resetting quota after a plan change). For admin tools use
AdminSetQuota.

post.summary:
AddOwnerQuota atomically increments an owner's quota by delta_bytes
(positive for purchase, negative for refund). Caller is responsible for
idempotency (e.g. deduplicate by order ID upstream).

get.summary: GetMyQuota returns the calling user's storage quota.

post.summary: GetSTSCredential returns STS temporary credentials for client-side upload.

BatchGetSTSCredential returns shared STS credentials plus per-file upload
tokens / instant results for a batch of files. The shared STS credential
is fetched once and reused across all files in the batch.
GenerateUploadURL returns a pre-signed upload URL or instant upload result.

CancelUpload cancels a pending upload session. Best-effort: only succeeds
when the session is still PENDING. The OSS object is NOT deleted (the
client may still be uploading); GC reclaims orphaned objects later.
ConfirmUpload confirms a file upload and creates the file record.

deltaBytes.description: delta_bytes may be negative (refund) or positive (purchase).

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

ops.description:
ops is optional. Empty = plain download URL; non-empty = image
processing URL (only supported by providers whose CDN+origin combo
can process images, currently Aliyun OSS+CDN).
NOTE: no min_items validation — empty ops = plain download.

ttl.description:
ttl is optional. If unset, defaults to storage.cdn.default_ttl.
Clamped to [min_ttl, max_ttl]. Ignored when public=true.

public.description:
public requests an unsigned CDN URL for public resources (avatars,
thumbnails). The URL has no auth_key/Signature query params and is
permanent (no expiry). Requires file.is_public=true; otherwise
BAD_REQUEST. CDN console must be configured to allow anonymous access
for these paths (path whitelist or public bucket ACL).

filename.description:
filename, when set, adds response-content-disposition=attachment to the
URL query so browsers download (rather than inline-display) the resource
under this filename. CDN-side requirements apply — see
CDNURLOptions.Filename doc for the per-vendor deployment checklist.

filename, when set, overrides the response-content-disposition filename
browsers save the download as. Empty falls back to the file's stored
Filename (uf.Filename). Use this when the caller wants to download under
a different name than the one stored on the file record.

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

clearMetadata.description:
clear_metadata explicitly clears the existing metadata map. Without this
flag, proto3 cannot distinguish "leave metadata unchanged" from "set
metadata to empty" because map fields default to an empty map.

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AuditAction.description: AuditAction represents types of auditable operations.

v1AuditLogStatus.description: AuditLogStatus represents the result of an audited operation.

v1AuditLogTargetType.description: AuditLogTargetType represents the kind of resource an audited operation touched.

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

allowedExtensions.description:
allowed_extensions is batch-level (the whole batch shares one STS
credential); per-file restrictions would require one AssumeRole call per
file, defeating batch's round-trip savings.

accessKey.description:
Shared STS credential for the whole batch. All per-file uploads use the
same temporary credential; the client differentiates by upload_token.

items.description: items are ordered to match request.files.

v1BucketACL.description: BucketACL represents bucket access control levels.

uploadToken.description:
upload_token is the signed token returned by GenerateUploadURL or
GetSTSCredential. The service verifies its HMAC signature, expiration,
owner, and vendor before finalizing the upload.

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

url.description: url is the signed CDN URL. Expires at the time indicated by expires_at.

expiresAt.description:
expires_at is the Unix timestamp at which the URL signature becomes
invalid. After this time the CDN returns 403.

vendor.description:
vendor is optional. If set (non-UNSPECIFIED), the service validates that
the resolved bucket belongs to this vendor; mismatch returns
BUCKET_VENDOR_MISMATCH. Leave UNSPECIFIED to skip the check (legacy behavior).

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

uploadToken.description:
upload_token is an HMAC-signed, self-contained token carrying all upload
metadata (owner, bucket, vendor, md5, size, etc.). The client must return
it verbatim to ConfirmUpload. Named "token" not "id" because it carries
state and signature, not just an identifier.

vendor.description: vendor is optional. Same semantics as GenerateUploadURLRequest.vendor.

ttl.description: ttl is optional. If unset, uses storage.sts.default_ttl. Capped at storage.sts.max_ttl.

allowedExtensions.description:
allowed_extensions restricts which file suffixes the issued STS credential
may PUT. Each element must start with '.' (e.g. ".jpg"). Enforced by OSS
at PUT time (Resource wildcards in STS policy). Empty = no restriction.
Service normalizes to lowercase; ".JPG" matches [".jpg"].

requestId.description: request_id is optional. If set, recorded in audit logs for traceability.

v1ImageResizeMode.description:
ImageResizeMode controls how images are resized.

 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_FIT: lfit — fit within bounds
 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_FILL: fill — crop to fill
 - IMAGE_RESIZE_MODE_PAD: pad — fit with padding

v1Owner.description: Owner identifies the owner of a resource (user, group, business, etc.).

v1OwnerType.description: OwnerType classifies who owns a file (user, system, group, etc.).

v1Pong.description: Pong is the health-check response — only public, non-sensitive info.

fileId.description: file_id is set when MD5 dedup hit (instant). upload_token is empty in that case.

objectKey.description:
object_key is the full OSS object path the client must PUT to (e.g.
"<keyPrefix>/<md5[:2]>/<md5>"). Empty when file_id is set (instant dedup,
no upload needed). Single-file GetSTSCredential callers read object_key
from the top-level response; batch callers read it from each item.

v1UploadTokenInfo.description:
UploadTokenInfo carries either an upload_token (client must ConfirmUpload
after the upload) or a file_id when MD5 dedup hit (instant upload).

v1Vendor.description: Vendor classifies storage backends (cloud storage providers).
